aboutText: AnyPS5 runs PS5 games natively on Windows and Linux: the relinker turns a game into a program of this computer, with the system libraries AnyPS5 implements.
welcomeSubtitle: Play PS5 games on your PC. Let's set a few things up first.
startingText: The game is opening, please wait. The first start can take a few minutes while it builds its shaders.
noToolkit: No AnyPS5 engine yet: download it in Settings › AnyPS5 engine.
saveSyncDetail: Saves and trophies stay the same on your other computers through %@.
saveSyncNoFolder: Saves and trophies stay the same on your other computers through a folder. Choose one first.
syncFolderNone: None yet. Choose a OneDrive, Dropbox, Syncthing or shared folder.
toolkitDetail: The relinker and system libraries for this system.
chooseToolkitSubtitle: The engine turns your PS5 games into programs for this PC. AnyPS5 downloads it from GitHub and keeps it up to date, or you can use a build of your own.
engineOffline: GitHub could not be reached. Try again, or use your own folder.
engineOwnFolderDetail: The relinker and libs/ from an AnyPS5 build.
engineUnverified: GitHub gave no checksum for this version. Select it again to download it anyway.
engineUnverifiedDetail: GitHub gave no checksum for %@; only go on if you trust it.
engineNoDownload: This release has no engine for this system
engineUpToDate: The AnyPS5 engine is up to date (%@)
engineUpdateToast: AnyPS5 engine %@ is out: Settings › AnyPS5 engine
engineGamesToUpdate: Update and play offered for installed games: %d
engineOwnChosen: Using your own engine folder as it is
engineOwnCheckoutChosen: Using your engine checkout: Update from Git in Settings pulls and builds it
engineOwnDetail: A folder you built or unpacked yourself, with the relinker and libs/ at its top, used as it is. Or a git checkout of the engine's source: then Update from Git pulls and builds it for you.
engineOwnInUse: %@ · used as it is: after a git pull, build it again yourself; installed games then offer Update and Play
engineOwnCheckout: %@ · a git checkout of the engine: Update from Git below pulls and builds it; installed games then offer Update and Play
engineGitUpdateDetail: git pull, the submodules, then builds the relinker and libraries in %@. Your own changes must be committed first.
engineGitNoBuild: No build folder yet: set one up once with CMake as the build guide shows (select to open it). Then this pulls and builds it.
engineGitBuiltAt: Nothing new to pull; engine built at %@
engineGitNoGit: Git isn't installed, or isn't on PATH
engineGitNoCmake: CMake isn't installed, or isn't on PATH
engineGitNotGit: this folder isn't a Git checkout
engineGitDirty: the folder has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them, then try again
engineGitNoBuildReason: there's no build folder yet. Set one up with the build guide
engineGitRelinkAllDetail: Installed games made with the previous build: %d. Saves and trophies stay.
engineGitBeforePlayDetail: Before a game starts, checks the remote. If there are new commits, pulls and builds first, then relinks the game. Skipped when offline.
engineGitBeforePlayStart: New engine commits: updating from Git before the game starts
engineGitPlayAnyway: Couldn't update the engine: %@ · playing with the current build
engineUpdateAndPlayDetail: Downloads AnyPS5 engine %@ (%@), then unlocks the game again; saves and trophies stay.
engineGlibc: Games need glibc %@ or newer; this system has %@
engineGlibcDetail: This engine was built for newer Linux systems (such as Ubuntu 24.04): its games will not start here.
resolutionReinstall: Takes effect when the game is installed again.
linkModeHard: Game files are linked to the dump and take no extra space
phoneServerDetail: AnyPS5 Remote on the same network finds this PC.
backUpSavesDetail: Saves and trophies, into the AnyPS5 Backups folder.
screenshotsDetail: F12 in a game, and a picture every time you earn a trophy.
screenshotsNone: No pictures yet: press F12 in the game, or earn a trophy.
trophyShot: The moment you earned it · Enter to open
displayUpstream: Upstream's engine ignores this: the launcher presses its F11 once the game opens. The AnyPS5-ARM engine does it itself.
windowSizeUpstream: Upstream's engine opens at 60%: the launcher resizes its window. The AnyPS5-ARM engine opens at this size.
engineUpstreamName: Upstream's release builds of boykopovar/AnyPS5, downloaded from GitHub into the launcher's own folder. Not a git clone of yours: nothing is pulled or built, and it changes only when you download another version below
engineArmName: AnyPS5-ARM's signed release builds, downloaded from GitHub: phone controller, full screen and window size. It changes only when you download a newer one here
engineArmWhy: The AnyPS5-ARM engine opens games full screen or at the window size you chose, and takes the phone controller
engineArmWhyDetail: Built from AnyPS5-ARM on top of upstream's engine; downloaded from AnyPS5-ARM's signed GitHub releases.
engineArmNone: AnyPS5-ARM has no engine for this system yet
engineArmUpToDate: The AnyPS5-ARM engine is up to date
engineUpstreamMainDetail: Upstream AnyPS5's main as it is, built each day by AnyPS5-ARM and signed. Untested: games may not start.
togetherIntroDetail: Your profile, trophies and friends, online. No password: a code by email or from the website.
togetherWithWebsiteDetail: Get a code here, type it on your phone or any computer.
togetherSignedOutElsewhere: Signed out of AnyTogether from another device
togetherCodeExpired: The code has expired; ask for a new one
togetherCodeLocked: Too many wrong codes; ask for a new one
togetherTooMany: Too many codes for now; try again later
togetherWithPhoneDetail: If %@ is signed in to AnyTogether, one tap there approves it.
togetherPhoneDeclined: The phone did not approve; sign in to AnyTogether on the phone first
profileMineDetail: Your games, play time and trophies.
togetherNoLinks: Names and bios can't carry links
togetherMediaServerOff: This server lets at most %d watch at once
partyStartDetail: Invite friends, play and talk together.
partyOpenDetail: Your friends can walk in without an invite.
partyKicked: You were removed from the party
togetherServerInvalid: Type an https:// address (http:// only for this computer or the home network)
gameVersionMismatch: %@ plays version %@ of the game; yours is %@
gameEngineMismatch: %@ plays on AnyPS5 %@, you on %@: update to the same one
togetherFriendsJoinDetail: While you play, friends see it and can start the same game to join.
togetherOnlinePlayDetail: Games see you signed in as @%@ with your AnyTogether friends and reach the other players directly or through AnyTogether's relay, never Sony. What they ask for goes to a log. From the next game start.
togetherOnlineLogDetail: What each game asked for online, one file per game, for a bug report.
voicePushToTalkOn: Hold %@ to talk, in a game too.
voicePushToTalkOff: %@ turns the microphone on and off, in a game too.
voiceNoMic: No microphone could be opened: check that one is plugged in and that apps may use it
voiceMovedPhone: The party's voice is on your phone now
voiceMovedAway: The party's voice moved to your other device
voiceOnPhone: You talk and listen on your phone now.
voiceOnOtherDevice: You talk and listen on your other device now.
friendsSignIn: Sign in to see your friends
friendsYourHandle: Yours is @%@: give it to your friends.
voiceTalkKeyDetail: Choose it, then press the key you want.
voiceTalkKeyHere: Works while AnyPS5 is in front: this desktop does not let apps read keys from other windows.
messagesEditLimit: This message can't be edited any more.
messagesUnsendConfirm: Unsend this message for everyone? It can't be undone.
conversationPinFull: You can pin up to %@ conversations.
e2eeOnDetail: Only your devices and %@'s can read the messages and attachments here. Not even the server can.
e2eeOffDetail: %@ uses an app that does not support it yet. Messages here work as before.
e2eeNoDevice: %@ is not signed in on a device that can read encrypted messages. They need an up-to-date app.
e2eeSafetyHow: Compare these numbers with %@ in person or on a call. If they match, nobody is in between.
e2eeDevicesChanged: %@'s devices changed. Compare the safety number again.
e2eeMyDevicesChanged: Your devices changed. Compare the safety number again.
e2eeNewDeviceNote: A new device cannot read messages sent before it was added.
e2eeBeforeDevice: Sent before this device was added.
e2eeUndecryptable: This message could not be decrypted.
e2eeReportNote: Reporting sends this message to the moderators so they can read it.
messagesReportWhy: Why are you reporting this message?
messagesReported: Thanks. The moderators will look at it.
readReceiptsHint: When off, people don't see when you've read their messages, and you don't see theirs. Delivered still shows.
partyCodeMakeDetail: Anyone with the code can ask to join.
partyCodeDetail: Join code · they ask, you decide.
partyAsksCode: %@ asks to join with your code
partyRequestDeclined: Your request to join was turned down
partyDiscordDetail: Everyone in the party can open it.
partyDiscordWrong: Use a discord.gg or discord.com link
partyCodeInvited: You're invited; the invite is above
partyCodeSharePlay: That's a Share Play code; here you can join parties
showcaseHint: Pin up to six trophies and games.
showcaseSaveFailed: The showcase could not be saved
profileThemeFailed: The profile theme could not be changed
compareTrophiesDetail: Your games and trophies next to theirs.
compareLead: Games either of you has trophies in, the ones you both play first.
compareNoGames: Neither of you has trophies yet.
compareNoTrophies: No trophy list for this game yet.
presenceOnlineDetail: Friends see you online and what you play.
presenceDndDetail: Friends see that you do not want to be disturbed.
presenceStatusNotYet: Idle and do not disturb are not available on this server yet
presenceHint: Friends see you as offline. Messages, parties and cloud saves keep working.
presenceNotYet: Appearing offline is not available on this server yet
askKick: Remove %@ from the party? They need a new invite to come back.
askMakeLeader: Make %@ the party leader? Only they can give it back.
askLeaveParty: Leave the party? Voice ends for you, and an invite-only party takes a new invite to get back in.
askEndTogether: End Play Together for everyone? The others stay in their game, alone.
askLeaveTogether: Leave the game? Your game keeps running, without the others.
askRemoveFriend: Remove %@ from your friends? You need a new request to be friends again.
requiredTooOld: This AnyPS5 is too old for AnyTogether
requiredTooOldVersion: AnyPS5 %@ is too old for AnyTogether
requiredDetail: AnyTogether needs %@ or newer. Friends, parties, messages and cloud saves wait for the update; your games still play.
requiredDownloadDetail: Opens the downloads page in your browser.
requiredToast: AnyTogether needs AnyPS5 %@ or newer: Settings › About
togetherStartDetail: Everyone in the party gets a Join. Online play turns on for this game only.
togetherPickDetail: Pick a game on Home first, then start it here for the party.
togetherStarted: Playing %@ together. The party can join now
togetherAlready: Your party is already playing together
togetherJoinDetail: Starts it here with online play on, in the same game.
togetherSignInFirst: Sign in to AnyTogether to join
togetherMissing: You need %@ in your library to join
togetherVersionYou: You need %@ version %@; you have %@. Add the update to your library
togetherVersionHost: %@ has version %@; you have %@. Ask them to update
togetherEngineYou: %@ plays on AnyPS5 %@; yours is %@. Update AnyPS5 to join
togetherEngineHost: %@ plays on AnyPS5 %@; yours is %@. Ask them to update
togetherUpdatingFirst: Updating %@ to the host's engine, then joining
playTogetherCodeDetail: Lets someone outside the party in.
togetherTryAnywayDetail: Join with your version. The game may not find the others, or may misbehave.
desktopUpdateLaterDetail: Restart now, or it goes in at the next launch.
desktopUpdateApplyFailed: The update could not be put in place: %@
desktopUpdateNoAnswer: No answer from GitHub: it asks again in a while
controllerVibrationDetail: Soft pulses for select, back, errors, trophies, invitations and the end of a row; never while a game is in front.
desktopUpdateAvailable: AnyPS5 Desktop %@ is out: Settings › About
desktopUpToDate: AnyPS5 Desktop is up to date (%@)
desktopUpdateDetail: %@ · %@ · signed release, checked before it is kept.
desktopUpdateReady: AnyPS5 Desktop %@ is downloaded and its signature checked: run it to update
desktopUpdateNoFile: This release has no download for this system.
engineUpstreamUnsigned: Checked with GitHub's checksum: upstream AnyPS5 does not sign its releases
engineUnsignedDetail: %@ came out before releases were signed: only GitHub's checksum checks it.
engineUnsigned: This release came out before releases were signed. Select it again to download it anyway.
padNoneDetail: Plug one in with a USB cable or pair it over Bluetooth; the troubleshooter below says what to check.
padTestDetail: Every button, both sticks and the triggers, live.
padVibrateDetail: A few strong pulses on Player 1's controller.
padLightDetail: DualSense and DualShock 4, while the launcher is in front; games set their own.
padConfirmDetail: Circle confirms and Cross goes back, as on Japanese consoles; the hints follow.
padDeadzoneDetail: A resting stick's drift is ignored, in the launcher and in games that set no dead zone of their own.
padAssistDetail: Another device plays player 1 together with you: its buttons and sticks join yours. Good for helping with a hard part, or for anyone who plays better with a second pair of hands.
gyroDetail: Turn the controller or the phone to move the right stick.
gyroActivationDetail: L2 suits aiming down the sights.
gyroDeadzoneDetail: A hand held still moves nothing; turns slower than this are ignored.
padAllGoodDetail: Read with %@; games read the same controllers through SDL.
padCopied: Command copied: paste it into a terminal
padTestNoPad: Connect a controller to test it
padFinding_noControllersDetail: Neither over USB nor over Bluetooth. Check the tips below, then press the PS, Xbox or Home button.
padFinding_usbCable: USB: a cable that carries data
padFinding_usbCableDetail: Many cables only charge. Use the controller's own cable or one you know moves files, straight into the computer.
padFinding_bluetoothPairing: Bluetooth: pair it in the system settings
padFinding_bluetoothPairingDetail: DualSense and DualShock 4: hold PS and Create (Share) until the light flashes. Xbox: hold the pair button. Switch Pro: hold the sync button. Then add it as a Bluetooth device.
padFinding_dualShock3Windows: DualShock 3 needs a driver on Windows
padFinding_dualShock3WindowsDetail: Install DsHidMini and set the controller to SDF or SXS mode; in XInput mode it shows as an Xbox pad.
padFinding_dualShock3Linux: DualShock 3 works over USB at once
padFinding_dualShock3LinuxDetail: Linux reads it on its cable; over Bluetooth it must be paired once with sixpair or the desktop's Bluetooth settings.
padFinding_unmappedDetail: It is seen but its buttons are unknown; Steam or SDL GameControllerDB can map it.
padFinding_lowBatteryDetail: Charge it: a nearly empty controller drops its connection.
padFinding_lowBatteryLevelDetail: Charge it soon. The controller reports only a rough level. Some controllers report it wrong over Bluetooth.
padFinding_steamPlayStation: Steam's PlayStation controller support is on
padFinding_steamPlayStationDetail: Outside its own games Steam turns the pad into a mouse and keys, so presses land twice. Turn it off in Steam › Settings › Controller, quit Steam, or start AnyPS5 from Steam (Add to Steam).
padFinding_steamRunningDetail: If the controller moves the pointer or presses twice, quit Steam or turn off its controller support.
padFinding_steamLaunchedDetail: Steam's virtual controller is the one read; the real one is left to Steam.
padFinding_ds4windowsDetail: It turns your PlayStation pad into a virtual Xbox pad. The launcher reads the real one and ignores the copy; games may see both. Quit it, or hide the real pad with HidHide.
padFinding_dualSenseXDetail: It turns your DualSense into a virtual Xbox pad. The launcher reads the real one and ignores the copy; games may see both. Quit it while playing here.
padFinding_hidHideDetail: If it hides your controller, add AnyPS5 Desktop to its applications in HidHide Configuration Client, or turn hiding off. Select to copy the launcher's path.
padFinding_vigemDetail: Its virtual Xbox pads show beside real controllers while a remapping program runs.
padFinding_linuxPermissionDetail: Your user may not open its /dev/input node. Add yourself to the input group, then log out and in. Select to copy the command.
padFinding_linuxHidraw: PlayStation pads without vibration and light
padFinding_linuxHidrawDetail: Their hidraw nodes are closed to your user, so they are read without motors or light bar. Select to copy a udev rule that opens them (Steam installs the same).
padFinding_sdlMissingWindowsDetail: Controllers are read the older way: PlayStation pads do not vibrate. Reinstall AnyPS5 Desktop. (%@)
padFinding_sdlMissingLinuxDetail: Controllers are read the older way, without vibration on PlayStation pads. Select to copy the install command. (%@)
browserPlayDetail: A phone scans a QR code and its browser is the pad.
browserPlayOff: Off: nothing is served on the network
browserPlayShowDetail: Scan it with the phone's camera.
browserPlayKeepDetail: Phones let in before can come back without a new code while AnyPS5 is open.
browserPlaySubtitle: Any phone becomes a controller, no app needed. Up to four players with the phone app's seats.
browserPlayStep1: Join the same Wi-Fi as this PC.
browserPlayStep2: Scan the code with the phone's camera and open the link.
browserPlayStep3: Allow the phone here when it asks. The same code shows on both screens.
browserPlayRenews: A new code in %@:%@ · each one works once
browserPlayNoNetwork:
No local network.
Join Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
familyAskedToPlay: Asked a parent to let you play %@
familyAskTimeDetail: A parent answers on the AnyTogether website.
familyAskedTime: Asked a parent for %d more minutes
familyAskMoreTime: Ask a parent for more time
familyOneMinute: One minute left: time to save
familyClosesIn: Time's up. The game closes in %d min: save now
familyClosesNow: Time's up. The game closes now
familyTimeUpNotify: Time's up for today. Finish up, or ask a parent for more time
familyStale: Limits from %@: connect to the internet to refresh them
familyLockedOut: Family settings could not be checked: connect to the internet
familyLockedOutDetail: The saved family settings were changed on this computer. Games start again once AnyTogether is reached.
familyUpToDate: Family settings are up to date
familySignInToAsk: Sign in to AnyTogether to ask a parent.
familyAskFriend: Ask a parent to add them
familyNoVoiceDetail: A parent has turned voice chat off.
familyServerLocked: A parent's settings keep this server.
familyNotAllowed: A parent's family settings don't allow this
familyOtherSide: This person's family settings don't allow it
familyNoFriendRequests: A parent's settings don't allow this friend request
familyNoMessages: A parent's settings don't allow messages here
familyNoSharePlay: A parent has turned share play off
familyNoPublic: A parent's settings keep this to friends
familyNoProfile: A parent's settings keep your profile private
familyNoDiscovery: A parent has turned this off
familyNoMedia: A parent has turned sharing pictures and clips off
familyNoAge: This game is rated for older players: ask a parent
fontsMissing: None: games get no font for it
fontsCjkLater: Downloads the first time a game needs it (100 MB)
fontsCjkDownload: Download Japanese, Chinese and Korean now
fontsCjkRemove: Remove Japanese, Chinese and Korean fonts
fontsCjkForGame: Downloading Japanese, Chinese and Korean fonts for %@ · %d%%
fontsCjkNeeded: %@ needs Japanese, Chinese or Korean fonts: downloading them (100 MB)
fontsCjkReady: Japanese, Chinese and Korean fonts are ready
fontsCjkReadyRestart: Japanese, Chinese and Korean fonts are ready: start the game again
fontsCjkFailed: The Japanese, Chinese and Korean fonts were not downloaded: %@
fontsCjkRemoved: Japanese, Chinese and Korean fonts removed
fontsOwnNone: None: choose a folder with the console's fonts (SST-Roman.otf, …)
fontsOwnRemoveDetail: The folder and its files stay where they are.
fontsOrderDetail: Your folder's files come first; the launcher's fonts fill in what it lacks. Noto fonts: SIL Open Font License 1.1.
showHiddenTrophiesDetail: Hidden trophies show their name and description before you earn them.
steamNotFoundDetail: Install Steam and sign in once, then come back here.
steamFlatpakNote: Flatpak Steam only sees your home folder: keep the AnyPS5 AppImage there.
steamAddDetail: AnyPS5 in your Steam library with its artwork: start it from Big Picture or a Steam Deck.
steamGamesDetail: Every unlocked game as its own Steam entry with its art, starting straight into the game.
steamRemoveDetail: Takes out only AnyPS5's entries and their pictures.
steamRunningDetail: Steam writes over its shortcuts when it closes: close it first, or let AnyPS5 close it.
steamAdded: Added to Steam: %@. Open Steam to find it in the AnyPS5 collection.
steamRemoved: AnyPS5 is no longer in Steam
steamWouldNotClose: Steam did not close. Quit it from its menu, then try again.
steamFromSteam: AnyPS5 was started from Steam. To change Steam's shortcuts, open AnyPS5 on its own (on a Steam Deck, in Desktop Mode).
steamPlayMissing: Steam asked for %@, which is not in your games folder
steamPlayLocked: %@ is not unlocked yet: unlock it, then start it from Steam again
prepareNewGamesDetail: A game copied into the games folder unlocks in the background while you're not playing, so it's ready when you get to it. Never during a game or on a low battery.
newGameWaiting: New game: %@ · Prepares after your game
newGamesWaiting: %d new games · Prepare after your game
newGameNotPreparedBattery: New game: %@ · Plug in to prepare it
newGameNotPreparedSpace: New game: %@ · Not enough space to prepare it
startsWhenReady: %@ starts as soon as it's ready
notPreparedBattery: %@ wasn't prepared: the battery is low
notPreparedSpace: %@ wasn't prepared: it needs %@, %@ is free
noSpaceAmount: Needs %@ · %@ free where your games folder is
noSpaceNothingWritten: The unlock did not start and nothing was written. Make room, or unlock into a games folder on a drive with more space.
noSpaceWhy: Unlocking writes the game's executable and modules converted for this PC. Linked game files take no extra space; copied ones take their whole size.
noSpaceCopying: Most of it is the game's files, which must be copied: %@
noSpaceFolder: Choose a games folder on a drive with more room
noSpaceFolderDetail: On the dump's drive the game's files are linked, so they cost nothing.
useDisplayDefaultsDetail: Display, window size and vertical sync back to Settings › Default display.
presetsIntro: Games that support Game Presets start with these settings. A game that keeps its own settings uses those once you change them in it.
presetPriorityDetail: Favour a higher frame rate, or a sharper picture.
windowButtons: Window buttons at the top edge
windowButtonsDetail: In full screen, moving the pointer to the top edge brings down Minimize, Leave Full Screen and Quit.
pauseOnMenu: Pause game when opening the menu
pauseOnMenuDetail: PS in a game presses the game's Options first, so it pauses under the quick menu.
closeGameDetail: Progress since your last save is lost.
launcherReportCrashClosing: AnyPS5 crashed while it was closing
launcherReportSendDetail: Opens a GitHub issue filled in with the version, the system and the launcher's last seconds, your folders and names taken out. Nothing is sent until you submit it there.
launcherReportLaterDetail: Not asked again about this one.
launcherReportCopied: The report was too long for the link, so the whole of it is on the clipboard. Paste it into the issue.
replayBufferDetail: While you play, the last minutes and the game's sound are kept in a temporary folder. Nothing is saved unless you press Share. The graphics card encodes the picture when it can. Otherwise it costs about one CPU core (720p, 30 fps).
replayNoScreen: Not available here: Wayland lets no program record the screen. Use an X11 session
replayNoFfmpeg: Needs ffmpeg: install it, or put ffmpeg beside AnyPS5
replayFailed: The replay buffer could not start
capturesHowClip: %@: save the last minutes as a clip · %@: screenshot. They go to the game's gallery
capturesHowShot: %@ or %@: screenshot into the game's gallery. Turn the replay buffer on to save clips
screenshotFailed: The screenshot could not be taken
clipFailed: The clip could not be saved
shortcutWaiting: Press a key, or buttons on the controller (hold them for a long press)
shortcutReserved: AnyPS5 moves with that one: choose another
shortcutsHowDetail: Select one, then press a key or the controller's buttons, several together for a chord. Esc or Circle cancels; Triangle or Delete clears it. Keys work while AnyPS5 is in front, the controller in games too.
shortcutsGameButtonsDetail: Keys for the game's buttons are set per game: Game Settings › Controls.
profilePickerSubtitle: Each profile has its own saves, trophies and settings.
profilePickerSubtitleLaunch: Pick your profile to carry on where you left off.
profileHowToPlay: How do you want to play?
profileHowToPlaySubtitle: You can switch between offline and online later from Options.
profileOfflineFact1: Trophies and progress stay on this PC
profileOfflineFact3: Go online any time from Options
profileOnlineLead: Create an AnyTogether account or sign in to yours.
profileOnlineFact3: Sign in with an email code, the website or your phone
profileSignInNew: Create an account or sign in
profileSignInSubtitle: New to AnyTogether? The email code makes your account as it signs you in.
profileGoOfflineDetail: Trophies and progress stay on this PC until you go online again.
profileGoOnlineDetail: Friends, parties and syncing with AnyTogether.
profileWaitForSync: Wait until the saves are synced
profileNowOffline: Offline: trophies and progress stay on this PC
profileSavesNotSwapped: %@'s saves could not be put in place for this profile
profileOnlineSignedOut: Online, signed out: sign in under AnyTogether
profileOfflineDetail: Offline: trophies and progress stay on this PC and are not synced.
profilePictureDetail: A PNG, JPEG or WebP, cut to a square. Shown on this PC only.
profilePictureFailed: That file could not be read as a picture
profileAskEveryTime: Ask who's playing at every start
profileAskEveryTimeDetail: With more than one profile the launcher always asks.
profileDeleteQuestion: Delete %@? Their saves and trophies on this PC are backed up to the Backups folder, then removed.
profileAddDetail: Someone else who plays on this PC.
profileCannotDelete: This profile cannot be deleted now
profileOfflineTogetherDetail: Trophies and progress stay on this PC. Go online to sign in or create an account.
privateDetail: Only your accepted friends see them, always next to your @handle. Everyone else sees your public name and picture.
privateNameSaved: Friends now see your private name
privatePictureDetail: A PNG or JPEG friends see in place of your public picture.
privatePictureSaved: Friends now see your private picture
privatePictureFailed: The picture could not be uploaded
checkForUpdatesDetail: See whether GitHub has a newer release.
updateChannelStableDetail: Releases that were tried before they came out.
updateChannelNightlyDetail: The newest engine build of main, offered in the engine picker. New things come first, and new bugs too.
checkUpdatesDetail: Tells you when a new AnyPS5 is out.
chooseFolderSubtitle: Choose the folder that holds your PS5 dumps. Subfolders are scanned too, and new games show up on their own.
chooseThemeSubtitle: You can change it later in Settings, or use your own picture or video.
clipSavedDetail: The last %d seconds · the game's settings → Screenshots.
clipsDetail: Create, ⌥F12 or the phone saves the last %d seconds to the gallery.
clipsNeedPermissionDetail: Allow AnyPS5 in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording.
clipsOffDetail: Turn them on in Settings → Behaviour → Clips.
controlsFromGame: Under each button is what the game's own files say it does.
controlsHint: Pick a row, then press the key you want for it. Esc cancels. A connected controller keeps its own buttons.
copyFixDeveloperModeThen: Turn Developer Mode on, then unlock the game again
copyFixFolder: Put your games folder on the same drive as your dumps
copyFixFolderDetail: Choose a folder on the dump's drive.
copyWarningLinux: %@ of game files will be copied, because the games folder cannot link to this dump: its drive cannot hold links. With the games folder on the dump's drive, the game uses the dump's files where they are.
copyWarningWindows: %@ of game files will be copied, because the games folder cannot link to this dump: the dump is on another drive, and Windows makes links across drives only with Developer Mode on. Either fix below lets the game use the dump's files where they are.
deadzoneDetail: How much of the travel reads as centered; stops a drifting stick.
diagnosisMissingModule: Missing module: %@. Unlocking the game again may fix it.
diagnosisOutOfMemory: The game ran out of memory.
diagnosisUnsupported: The game asked for a system function that is not supported yet: %@
discordPresence: Show the game you play on Discord
discordPresenceDetail: With Discord open, your profile shows the game and for how long.
discordJoin: Show a Join button on Discord
discordJoinDetail: In a party, the button opens its join page. You still say yes to who joins.
displayDefaultsDetail: How every game starts that leaves Display, Window Size and Vertical Sync at Default in its own settings. A game's own choice wins.
dumpMoved: The game's dump moved; unlock it again or put it back
emptyLibraryText: Put PS5 dumps in your games folder and they show up here on their own.
exportSettingsDetail: Keys and every setting in one file.
exportThemeDetail: One .anyps5theme file, to give to anyone.
folderAlreadyAdded: That folder is already in your library
folderRemoved: Folder removed from the library. Nothing on its drive was deleted.
folderNoGames: There is no PS5 game in that folder
fontsHint: F12 in a game saves a screenshot. Games that ask for the console's system fonts use the files in the fonts folder.
frameGenerationDetail: Experimental. Adds a frame between each two of the game's and turns on vertical sync.
frameGenerationLowPower: Low Power Mode is on: the display stays at 60 Hz, so frame generation cannot work
gameMusicDetail: The selected game's own theme song, when it has one.
hideWhilePlaying: Hide the launcher while a game runs
hubFailed: The Hub could not be reached. Try again
importSettingsDetail: Applies a settings file someone shared.
installedSize: Installed games are kept as APFS clones and take no extra space.
keyboardRampDetail: How long a key takes to tilt the stick fully.
linkCopied: Link copied. Opening it shows this game in the launcher.
lowPowerFrameGeneration: The display stays at 60 Hz, so frame generation cannot work. Turn it off in System Settings → Battery.
lowPowerRefresh: The display stays at 60 Hz, so the game stops at 60 fps. Turn it off in System Settings → Battery.
makeReportDetail: To attach on Discord or GitHub.
reduceTransparencyDetail: Solid surfaces instead of frosted glass.
glassFallback: Glass is drawn solid now, to keep the launcher smooth on this graphics card
glassTransparencyDetail: How much of your desktop and the windows behind shows through, blurred; text stays readable at every step, 0 % is solid.
glassTransparencySharp: How much of your desktop shows through; this desktop does not blur it, so Glass keeps more tint. 0 % is solid
glassArtworkDetail: Lays the selected game's picture over the desktop, frosted.
mouseCurveDetail: Above 1 gives finer control at low speed.
mouseDecayDetail: How soon the camera stops after the mouse does.
mouseMaxSpeedDetail: Keeps a fast flick at full tilt a little longer.
mouseMinimumDetail: Raise it if slow movement does not move the camera.
mouseSensitivityDetail: Higher turns fully with less movement.
mouseSmoothingDetail: Smooths jittery movement; off follows every report.
mouseVerticalDetail: Speeds up looking up and down against turning.
moveToApplicationsText: macOS opens downloaded apps from a locked, read-only copy. Let me move it to Applications and reopen it, so this never gets in the way again.
phoneConnectedDetail: mController is ready: play with the phone.
phoneOpenLauncher: %@ wants to connect: open the launcher to allow it.
phonePairingText: The phone shows the same code.
phoneServerFailed: The phone connection could not start
phoneUpstream: Games can't read the phone with this engine
phoneUpstreamDetail: Upstream's engine reads controllers and the keyboard only. The phone moves the launcher, and a game ignores it. Choose AnyPS5-ARM in Settings › AnyPS5 engine, then unlock your games again.
phoneUpstreamGame: The phone can't control this game. It runs on upstream's engine, which doesn't read the phone. Choose AnyPS5-ARM in Settings › AnyPS5 engine and unlock the game again.
phoneNoAnswer: The game hasn't answered the phone. Its engine may not read the phone. The AnyPS5-ARM engine does.
phoneWaiting: %@: becomes a player at its first press
remotePlayNeedsPermission: To send the game to the phone, allow AnyPS5 in System Settings > Privacy > Screen Recording.
reportFailed: The report could not be saved
upscalingDetail: Lower the Resolution and FSR 1 keeps it sharp.
upscalingUpstream: Upstream's engine always scales bilinearly. FSR 1 needs the AnyPS5-ARM engine.
fsrSharpnessDetail: In AMD's stops: 0 is the sharpest, 2 the softest.
restoreSavesDetail: The game's current saves are backed up first.
rosettaMissing: Games run through Rosetta, which this Mac does not have yet.
sectionMouse: Mouse as the camera (middle button or F7)
settingsFileFailed: This is not an AnyPS5 settings file
shaderCacheDetail: When off, shaders compile again at every start.
shareThemeDetail: Saves the file and opens the page to send it.
shareThemeHint: The theme in use, from the Studio.
launcherVolumeDetail: Everything the launcher plays: its sounds and music. 0 % is silent; games keep their own volume.
stickModifierScaleDetail: How far the sticks tilt while Slow Movement is held (set in Controls).
themeInstallFailed: The theme could not be installed
themeMusicDetail: Plays when the selected game has no song.
backgroundThemeOwn: The theme in use brings its own picture or video.
backgroundVideoNeedsFfmpeg: A video needs ffmpeg. Install it, or put ffmpeg beside AnyPS5.
menuMusicDetail: Plays when the selected game has no song. A theme's own music comes first.
themeSaveFailed: The theme could not be saved
themeShareNext: Attach the file on the page that opened
themesDetail: Yours and the ones people share.
triggerRampDetail: How long a key takes to press L2/R2 fully, for racing games.
trophyHiddenDetail: Shows what it is once you earn it.
uninstallConfirm: Remove the installation? Your game files stay; the game shows as locked again.
unlockErrorCopy: Select to copy the whole error.
unlockLeftOutEncrypted: %@ is ready, but some of its files are encrypted in the dump. If it does not start, dump it again.
unlockLeftOutNotRelinked: %@ is ready. A few of its files could not be converted and were left out.
unreadableDump: This dump is encrypted or damaged and cannot be opened.
updateAndPlayDetail: Brings AnyPS5's latest fixes; your saves and trophies stay.
updateAvailable: Can be installed again with the new version
updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates: GitHub did not answer
updateChoiceText: An update is ready for this game.
updateCloseGame: Close the game first to update
updateDetail: Downloads it, then the launcher opens again on the new version.
updateNotWritable: Move AnyPS5 to Applications to update it
useGamesFolderDetail: It holds %d games: %@. The launcher looks for games there from now on.
reportSaveDetail: The report and this start's whole log · to attach to an issue.
reportCopyDetail: The report and the last 200 log lines · for Discord or an issue.
reportOpenIssueDetail: On GitHub · you see what is shared first.
reportPlayTracedDetail: Once, for a fuller report · the game may run slower.
reportShareDetail: Your home folder, user and computer names, e-mail addresses and AnyTogether tokens are taken out. Nothing is sent until you submit the issue on GitHub yourself.
reportGitHubDetail: %@ · the engine's bug form, then drag crash_log.txt into it.
reportLauncherDetail: AnyTogether/AnyPS5-Desktop · when the launcher itself went wrong, same text.
reportNoLog: The game wrote nothing to its log.
reportNormal: No error found: the game closed normally.
reportSaveFailed: The report could not be saved
traceDetail: Slower. The log can get large.
traceOnNotice: Detailed logging is on: the game may run slower; the log is kept under 512 MB
lastSessionReportDetail: The log, the crash and this PC, to save, copy or report.
gameStartsAfterEngine: %@ starts once the engine is built.
gameWaitsForEngine: The engine is being built. Games can start once it is done.
gameUpdatingHint: %@ is being updated. Cancel Update in its settings stops it.
gameBusyUpdating: Not while it is being updated
gameBusyEngine: Not while the engine is being built
stopGameDetail: Asks the game to close so it can save, and ends it if it does not.
engineGitWaitUnlock: A game is being unlocked. Update from Git can run once it is done.
gameUnlockingHint: %@ is being unlocked and starts when it is done. Cancel Unlock in its settings stops it.
filesBusy: Wait until the files being unpacked or copied are done.
addUpdateDetail: Choose the folder of the game's update dump. It goes next to the game, and the game's own files stay as they are.
addUpdateOtherGame: That folder holds another game, not %@.
addUpdateNotNewer: That folder is no update. Its version is not newer than the game's %@.
addUpdateHaveNewer: The game has update %@ already, as new or newer.
addUpdateHaveOlder: The game has an update folder already (%@). Remove it first, then add the new one.
addUpdateNotADump: That folder is no game dump. It needs an eboot.bin and a sce_sys/param.json.
addUpdateAbout: The folder moves next to the game as %@. It is copied when it is on another drive and takes %@ there. The next unlock applies it.
addUpdateFailed: The update could not be added.
addUpdateMoved: The update for %@ is in place. Unlock the game again to apply it.
addUpdateCopied: The update for %@ is in place. Unlock the game again to apply it. The original folder can be deleted now.
unpackAbout: A game is inside. It unpacks into the folder %@ next to it.
unpackUpdateAbout: It is update %@ of this game. It unpacks into %@ next to the game, and the next unlock applies it.
unpackUnsafe: Some files in this zip would land outside its folder, so AnyPS5 does not unpack it.
unpackDone: %@ is unpacked. The zip can be deleted now.
unpackUpdateDone: The update for %@ is in place. Unlock the game again to apply it.
unpackFailed: %@ could not be unpacked. Nothing was left behind.
filesNoSpace: It needs %@ of free space, and the drive has %@.
filesKeepsGoing: It goes on in the background. AnyPS5 says when it is done.
cloudSaveSyncTogetherDetail: Saves and trophies stay the same on your other computers through your AnyTogether cloud.
cloudStorageFailed: Your cloud could not be read
cloudStorageOff: This AnyTogether server keeps no files yet
cloudStorageNoSaves: No saves in your cloud yet. Turn on Save Sync through AnyTogether and play.
cloudStorageRestoreDetail: It becomes the newest again. This computer takes it and backs up its own saves first.
cloudSavesDownloaded: Saves from %@ are on this computer
cloudConflictDetail: Your cloud has newer saves of %@ from %@ (%@). The ones you do not keep stay as a backup.
cloudQuotaReplaceDetail: There is room for %@ only if its newest cloud save (%@) is replaced by this computer's. Replace it?
cloudQuotaFull: Your cloud storage is full. Free some room in Settings › Behaviour › Cloud storage.
cloudTooBig: These saves are too big for your cloud
cloudOff: This AnyTogether server keeps no files yet
powerIntro: What a laptop on battery, or a computer running hot, does to the game you play. Plugged in and cool, nothing changes.
powerNoBattery: No battery, so only the heat profile applies
powerNoHeat: Temperature: this computer does not tell programs
powerLowPowerMode: Battery saver is on, so the battery profile holds
powerInForceNothing: Games run as you set them
powerUpstream: Upstream's engine ignores the game's part
powerUpstreamDetail: The frame cap and the frame generation pause need the AnyPS5-ARM engine. The lighter launcher works with every engine.
powerBatteryProfileDetail: On battery or with battery saver on. You get more play time and a quieter laptop.
powerHotProfileDetail: When the processor runs hot. A note shows over the game, and Undo is in the quick menu.
powerHeatUnavailable: The heat profile is not available here
powerHeatUnavailableDetail: This computer does not tell programs its temperature, so only the battery profile works.
powerFrameCapDetail: Changes at once, during a game too.
powerPauseFrameGenerationDetail: Changes at once, for games started with frame generation on.
powerDimEffectsDetail: Turns down the Glass blur and the animations.
powerUndoDetail: Back to your settings until the computer cools down or the power source changes.
powerHotDetail: Your computer is hot. %@. To undo, open the quick menu with PS.
powerQuickUndoDetail: Back to your settings for now.
frameGenerationUpstream: Upstream's engine has no frame generation. It needs the AnyPS5-ARM engine.
frameGenerationPaused: The battery or heat profile pauses it now. It comes back when that profile ends.
broadcastServerDetail: An rtmp:// or rtmps:// address. The key can be at its end.
broadcastKeyDetail: From your channel's dashboard. Type or paste it here. It shows as dots and never appears on screen.
broadcastKeyClipboardEmpty: There is no text on the clipboard
broadcastQualityDetail: Pick a lower one if frames drop. Your upload speed should be about 1.5 times this.
broadcastViewerLinkDetail: Where people watch, like twitch.tv/yourname. It shows while you are live, and you can copy it.
broadcastKeptPrivately: Stream keys stay in a file in the AnyPS5 settings folder that only your user account can read. They never go to AnyTogether.
broadcastGoLiveNoGame: Start a game to go live
broadcastSetUpFirstDetail: Add your stream key in Settings › Broadcasting.
broadcastReconnecting: Connection lost. Trying again in %d s
broadcastNoEncoder: ffmpeg has no H.264 encoder that works on this computer
broadcastProblemNotRtmp: The server's address does not start with rtmp:// or rtmps://
broadcastProblemNoHost: The server's address has no host
broadcastProblemNoApplication: The server's address has no application, like /live2
broadcastProblemNoKey: There is no stream key yet
remotePlayNoFfmpeg: Remote Play needs ffmpeg. Install it, or put ffmpeg beside AnyPS5
remotePlayNoScreen: Remote Play cannot record the screen on Wayland. Use an X11 session
sharePlayStartDetail: Friends watch live in a browser or their launcher. You can let them play as player 2, 3 or 4.
sharePlaySignInFirst: Sign in to AnyTogether to share play
sharePlayNoWindow: Share play could not read the game's window
sharePlayOpenToFriendsDetail: Friends can come in without an invite.
sharePlayMaxViewersDetail: Your computer sends a stream to each viewer. From three on, each stream is 540p at 30 fps.
sharePlayWatchDetail: Full screen here. Your controller plays once they let you.
sharePlayFull: Nobody else can watch right now
socialFeedSubtitle: What your friends have been playing.
socialFeedRowDetail: Friends' trophies, first plays and milestones.
socialFeedEmpty: Nothing from your friends yet. Trophies, first plays and long sessions show up here.
socialBoardNoGame: No one has played this on AnyTogether yet
socialBoardUnlisted: You're not on this board. It only lists people whose trophies and library are public.
socialBoardNothing: Nothing to rank yet. Play and earn trophies to get on the board.
socialBoardRowDetail: Trophy points among friends or everyone.
socialBoardGameRowDetail: Points, play time and completion, among friends or everyone.
socialCompatSubtitle: One tap tells everyone how far it gets on a PC.
socialCompatNothingDetail: Nothing showed, or it closed at once.
socialCompatBootsDetail: It started but stopped before the menus.
socialCompatMenusDetail: The menus work, but the game itself doesn't.
socialCompatPlayableDetail: It plays well, start to finish.
socialCompatNeverDetail: Reports can still be sent from the game's settings.
socialCompatNone: No reports yet. Tell the community.
discoverFindPlayersDetail: People looking for a group, public parties and people to meet.
discoverStartingSoonDetail: Now or within half an hour.
discoverFindForDetail: Post what you want to play. People who want in say I'm in.
discoverHubDetail: Who plays it now, posts, parties and the leaderboard.
discoverNoPostsDetail: Post one yourself. People who play it will see it.
discoverWaitingFor: Waiting for %@. Select to take it back.
discoverInSharePlay: You're in: they invited you to their share play
discoverInParty: You're in: they invited you to their party
discoverNoMineDetail: Open a game's settings and choose Find players.
discoverLetInCoop: Invited to your share play or your party
discoverTheyShare: In: invited to your share play
askClosePost: Close this post? Its requests go with it.
discoverAskedTitle: Posts you said I'm in to
discoverPublicPartiesDetail: Parties their leader opened to everyone.
discoveryDetail: Whether people who don't know you can find you.
discoverNoSuggestionsDetail: Play some games and set your languages.
discoverNoPlayers: Nobody shows their library for it yet
discoverNoPlayersDetail: People appear here when they show their library.
discoverCoopDetail: Over share play they join as player 2 to 4. Without it they join your party.
discoverStaysUpDetail: After it starts, for a day at most.
discoverPostDetail: Your post shows on the board for this game.
discoverSlowDown: Too many at once. Try again in a bit.
discoverTooManyPosts: At most three open posts. Close one first.
discoverYoureInParty: You're in! Your party invite is waiting
discoverYoureInShare: You're in! Your share play invite is waiting
discoverListPublicDetail: Others see it in Find Players.
discoverFindPartyDetail: Public parties and people looking for a group.
discoverShowMeDetail: In players of a game, suggestions and game hubs.
discoverLanguagesDetail: For suggestions and new posts. Up to five.
socialHubShareDetail: Uploads it to AnyTogether's Theme Hub.
socialHubTooLarge: The theme is too big for the Hub, 50 MB at most
socialHubBadTheme: The Hub didn't take this theme file
socialHubNoPreview: The Hub needs a picture of the theme
socialHubNoTheme: That theme isn't on the Hub
partyChatEmpty: Only the party reads this. Anyone who joins sees the messages so far.
messagesReportDetail: A moderator reads it. Its author is not told who sent the report.
messagesReported: Thanks. A moderator will look at it.
challengeJoinNote: Joining shows your progress in this challenge to everyone who can see it.
challengeMakeOnWeb: Make a challenge on the website
challengeYoursNote: You made this challenge. To call it off, open it on the website.
messagesGroupPick: Pick at least one friend first
joinDeafenDetail: Hear nobody, and your microphone is off.
profilePictureUploadDetail: Friends see it on your profile.
profilePictureFromTogetherDetail: The picture on your AnyTogether profile, on this PC too.
profilePictureDownloadFailed: Your AnyTogether picture could not be downloaded
profilePictureTooSmall: The picture is too small: at least 32 pixels
capturesClipTooBig: This clip is %@: it is made smaller to fit %@ before it goes up
capturesClipTooLongDetail: A post takes a clip of up to 1:00. Save a shorter one and share that.
capturesCommentsEmpty: No comments yet. Be the first.
capturesCommentsFailed: The comments could not be read.
capturesEmpty: No captures yet. Share a screenshot or clip from a game's gallery: Share → Share to AnyTogether.
capturesFailed: Captures could not be read. Check the connection and open them again.
capturesMore: Older captures load as you go
capturesPostSubtitle: Posted to Captures with the game it is from.
capturesRefusedBadMedia: AnyTogether could not take this file
capturesRefusedCommentsOff: The author turned comments off for this post
capturesRefusedFamilyFriends: Your family settings keep your posts to friends
capturesRefusedGone: This post is no longer there
capturesRefusedLink: That link is not allowed on AnyTogether
capturesRefusedMuted: Your account is muted for now: you cannot post or comment
capturesRefusedRateLimited: That was a lot at once: wait a moment and try again
capturesRefusedStorage: This AnyTogether server keeps no files, so it takes no captures
capturesRowDetail: Friends' screenshots and clips: like them, comment.
capturesShareToTogetherDetail: A post your friends can like and comment on.
capturesSubtitle: Screenshots and clips from you, your friends and players you met.
capturesVisibilityPublicDetail: Anyone on AnyTogether who is not blocked.
cloudCloudOff: This AnyTogether server keeps no files
cloudGalleryFull: Your gallery is full (%d): unpin something first
callAnsweredElsewhere: The call was answered on another device
